worldcombat.skill.tailglow.summary: Gather a slowly pulsing ring of firefly light and stare into it, drastically raising Sp. Atk. The trance is a visible glow: a solid hit taken during the window scatters it and the Sp. Atk is taken back early. Steady focus makes the light harder to break and last longer, at a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.tailglow.use.0: Focus before a fight to push Sp. Atk to the top
worldcombat.skill.tailglow.use.1: Enter the trance while the foe is out of reach and finish before contact
worldcombat.skill.tailglow.use.2: When cornered, focus and strike back, betting the foe cannot scatter the light in time
worldcombat.skill.tailglow.description.0: The trance raises Sp. Atk by %1$s.
worldcombat.skill.tailglow.description.2: A single hit for more than %1$s of max health scatters the light and takes the Sp. Atk back early.
worldcombat.skill.tailglow.steady.on: Steady: the trance window is longer and the scatter threshold higher (tougher against grazes), at a 3-tick longer wind-up and 14 ticks more cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.tailglow.steady.off: Quick: faster to start with a shorter cooldown, but a shorter window and a light easier to scatter.
worldcombat.skill.tailglow.timing: A self move with %1$s blocks of range; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.tailglow.growth.0: At level %1$s the trance window stretches to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.tailglow.growth.1: At level %1$s the trance window stretches further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.tailglow.preference.st: On: the trance window is multiplied by 1.25 and the scatter threshold by 1.6, at a 3-tick longer wind-up and 14 ticks more cooldown. Off: faster start and cooldown, but a shorter window and an easier-to-scatter light.
worldcombat.skill.tailglow.preference.ai: The trance is considered only against a threat within this distance; larger means starting earlier at longer range.
A threat closer than this makes the companion give up the trance and fight; larger is more cautious.
